answer:
**Recipients of the Ripple of Hope Award (before 2017) who also earned a Nobel Prize (before 2010)**  

| Person | Nobel Prize (Year) | Ripple of Hope Award Year |
|--------|-------------------|--------------------------|
| **Desmond Mpilo Tutu** | Nobel Peace Prize, 1984 | 2008 |
| **Al Gore** | Nobel Peace Prize, 2007 | 2011 |
| **Muhammad Yunus** | Nobel Peace Prize, 2006 | 2013 |

These three individuals satisfy both criteria:

1. They each received the **Ripple of Hope Award** at a time **before the year 2017** (the awards years shown above are all ≤ 2016).  
2. They received a **Nobel Prize** that was awarded **before the year 2010** (1984, 2006, and 2007, respectively).
